name: wpxmcp
description: MCP server for managing self-hosted WordPress sites — content, taxonomies, media, users, comments, plugins, themes, menus, widgets, design and SQL. Multi-site.

scripts.audit: node audit/run.mjs && node audit/run2.mjs && node audit/run3.mjs

WPX_AUTH_TOKEN.description: A long random shared secret that MCP clients must send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Without it the Worker refuses every request.

WPX_SITES.description: JSON array of the WordPress sites to manage, e.g. [{"id":"main","url":"https://example.com","username":"admin","appPassword":"abcd EFGH ijkl MNOP"}]. Create the appPassword in wp-admin under Users > Profile > Application Passwords.

WPX_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Optional. Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call this Worker, e.g. https://claude.ai. Leave empty for non-browser clients.
